answer: An agent marketplace requires every identity to lock $100 in escrow for 90 days before it can submit bids, with no bond reusable across active identities. An agent named violet faces the same rule as one named ember: a new name carries no trust signal by itself. Creating 10,000 bidding identities therefore ties up $1 million for three months, making a sybil swarm costly even when generating names and running agents is cheap.
